skill_name: Generate a creative story about a character who lives in a village with a secret.
workflow:
Once upon a time, there lived a young girl in a small village deep in a secluded wood. The village was filled with beautiful greenery and people of all ages living side by side. But behind all of that beauty, the village was keeping a big secret. It was said that the village was home to a mythical creature, living deep below the village and only coming out at night.
